mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase above 5.0% signals economic weakness that triggers a flight to quality, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate broad demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect is not significant (p-value > 0.05) in a regression of 60-day returns on the product of HOUST and RSAFS growth rates.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals supply chain disruptions that intensify during manufacturing slowdowns, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation that prompts Fed tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained non-farm payrolls growth above 150,000 per month indicates strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 150,000.

mechanism_narrative: High consumer spending (RSAFS > 450,000) supports robust corporate earnings growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days during demand expansion regimes.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS exceeds 450,000.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 99.0 signals manufacturing slowdowns that reduce corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is below 99.0.
